title: Domain Neutral Framework
description: Remove compose/sketchpad/kit/design domain leaks from framework technology. Move kit VFS schemas and helpers to compose. Keep framework domain-neutral.
summary: Removed compose/sketchpad/kit domain leaks from framework: moved KIT VFS schema and descriptor helpers to compose/sketchpad; generalized platform VFS demo (workspace/branch/leaf); added canDrag on node records; renamed puzzle5d command to puzzle5dSelection; removed sketchpad layout aliases and KIT schema fallback from renderer; neutralized framework tests and docs.
